backup_frontier_2.mathematical_frontier: Whether every integer orbit that stays in {1,2} mod 3 for all time enters -1 or {-2,-4}. Finite-window preimages and the fact that packet seeds are not avoiders do not decide that.
backup_frontier_2.observed_trigger: CLOSE_FALSE_OBSTRUCTION: {1,2} mod 3 is not a basin; packet seeds are not avoiders; -28 and -10 are strict preimages of the 2-cycle.
backup_frontier_2.why_current_machinery_is_already_close: Three affine branches, cycles, and expanding 0 mod 3 are already Lean-certified in MatthewsMod3.lean. The missing object is a predecessor grammar for genuine avoiders, not another window census.
backup_frontier_2.expected_mathematical_yield: A sound finite preimage quotient for the named cycles, or a splitting pair. Not a Matthews-prize solution.
backup_frontier_2.strongest_existing_counterexample: packet seeds are not avoiders; -28 and -10 are strict preimages of {-2,-4}
backup_frontier_2.cheapest_falsifier: Propose one residue quotient of bounded preimages of {-1} union {-2,-4} and split two states with identical class but different avoider behavior.
backup_frontier_2.target_reuse_value: Reuse the three-branch spec and existing cycle identities. Different family from the refuted avoider-as-basin lead.
backup_frontier_2.why_now: Same recurring image/basin limitation as 7x+1, with a second Lean module and named cycles already in hand. Cheaper than a Skolem vanishing procedure.
backup_frontier_2.recommendation: Test one bounded preimage quotient for the known cycles; do not claim the Matthews prize and do not rerun the false avoider obstruction.
